brain.commentary: Cross‑asset regime is flagged as stress while crypto market regime remains normal. The top‑tier assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) show elevated volatility, negative alpha and modest to negative composites, with SOL and LTC suffering from poor liquidity and weak institutional factor scores. Many of the lower‑tier altcoins have placeholder metrics (zero vol, zero alpha) which makes their signals fragile. Given the systemic stress and uneven risk profile, we tilt the portfolio toward a defensive stance, scaling back conviction on the most vulnerable signals and modestly trimming exposure across the boa
